## Details
### **SW-REQ-SIM-HARN-001** — Trick S_define Integration

- **Description:** The sim harness shall integrate sim_dynamics, sim_sensors, sim_scenario, and FSW POSIX into a single Trick simulation.
- **Rationale:** PM-required Trick top-level integration providing a single closed-loop SITL simulation for FT1 nav anchoring.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SIM-HARN-002** — Time-Stepped Sim Orchestration

- **Description:** The sim harness shall advance the simulation on a fixed time step driven by the Trick scheduler.
- **Rationale:** PM-required deterministic time-stepped orchestration so dynamics, sensors, and FSW execute in a repeatable order.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SIM-HARN-003** — Sensor-to-FSW Boundary

- **Description:** The sim harness shall deliver simulated sensor measurements to the FSW POSIX driver inputs each step.
- **Rationale:** PM-required boundary between Trick-side sensor models and the FSW POSIX driver layer for each scheduled step.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SIM-HARN-004** — POSIX FSW Execution Inside Sim

- **Description:** The sim harness shall execute the FSW POSIX applications and libraries in-process during each simulation step.
- **Rationale:** PM-required so Trick exercises the same FSW software paths used on flight hardware via the POSIX build.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SIM-HARN-005** — Scenario Configuration Selection

- **Description:** The sim harness shall select the scenario configuration via Trick command-line arguments at run start.
- **Rationale:** PM-required command-line scenario selection to enable batch runs and operator-driven configuration.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-045
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-SIM-HARN-006** — Reproducible Run Output

- **Description:** The sim harness shall produce identical run outputs given identical scenario configuration and random seed inputs.
- **Rationale:** PM-required reproducibility for regression analysis and FT1 nav anchoring across repeated Trick runs.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1
